title: aftergrid Reader profile
description: One named Reader profile. Lives in the Instance readers file; the Reader reviewer adopts it. The Engine ships one profile with id `generic` as the fallback.

label.description: Short human label, e.g. 'Non-technical product owner'.

role.description: What they do and what they are responsible for.

data_literacy.description: Highest level assumed. none: plain sentences only. reads_charts: one simple chart per point. reads_tables: small tables fine. writes_sql: never a Reader profile in v0; use for Operator reviewers only.

time_budget_minutes.description: How long they will spend before deciding. Drives how much sits above the fold.

decisions.description: Decisions this Reader makes with Findings.

will_misread.description: Known misreadings to write against, e.g. 'treats a correlation as a cause', 'reads a rate without asking for the denominator'.

vocabulary.description: Words to use and words to avoid, in their language.
